dayloom.note: KR master is a copy of Dayloom assets/fonts/LINESeedKR-Regular.otf (byte-identical); the other masters are read from the Dayloom checkout and pinned by sha256 in extra.localeMasters

master.license: OFL 1.1, no Reserved Font Name; docs/assets/fonts/OFL-LINESeedKR.txt

extra.note: codepoints: [lo,hi] runs per face. ko+rare partition the Hangul syllables of the KR master; ko is also used for every jamo. langs: the page languages that declare a face; preload: the languages whose pages preload it (they use at least one of its characters). Han faces hold only the ideographs in use (scanned); their unicode-range names the whole Han blocks so a missing ideograph falls back per character.
